requirement.description: Architecture must support 100,000 concurrent users with no degradation in performance.

evidence.note: This report transcribes the benchmark metrics recorded in the test execution report. It is not a claim that a new benchmark was executed while preparing this file. The GitHub Actions workflow runs a fresh benchmark on each applicable push or pull request and uploads its raw output as an artifact.

acceptance_evaluation.qualification: PASS applies to the virtual/in-memory benchmark only. It does not establish capacity for 100,000 real internet-connected clients or production infrastructure.

unreported_metrics.reason: The summary recorded in Test_Execution_Report.md does not provide these raw fields. They are intentionally left null rather than estimated or invented.

limitations: The benchmark uses virtual clients and in-memory gateway/pub-sub components.
It is not a real 100,000-client network or internet load test.
It does not establish production infrastructure, database, operating-system, or network capacity.
A fresh CI execution produces the raw benchmark output as a downloadable GitHub Actions artifact.
recommended_follow_up: Run the GitHub Actions workflow and retain the uploaded scalability-benchmark-report artifact.
If production-scale claims are required, perform a controlled multi-process and real-network load test against the intended deployment environment.
